title: War begins (Operation Epic Fury)
note: US/Israeli opening strikes; series has not started yet.

title: Forecast series starts
note: First daily Grok run. 18-month normality odds at 80%.

title: April lift / meeting window
note: Brief transit uptick around talks; blockade still in force. Odds peak above March on several horizons.

title: June MOU / memorandum peak
note: Islamabad/MOU ceasefire narrative. Medium-horizon odds briefly reprice reopening.

title: Summer gains largely reversed
note: MOU window has faded without a broader deal. Medium/long horizons back below spring highs.

title: Mid-November trough
note: Softest multi-horizon reading in the series. 18-month 62%; 6-month 28%.

title: Latest run / partial rebound
note: 18-month 68% (−12 vs March). Week rebound from the trough; medium/long horizons still below March.
